nodes.description: Owner address stored by OwnableUpgradeable; it gates the onlyOwner modifier used by mint() and _authorizeUpgrade().
Total OGV token supply, increased by ERC20Upgradeable._mint and decreased by _burn.
Mapping of account balances mutated by _mint and _transfer.
Initializable flag preventing initialize() from being executed more than once.
Immutable address of the implementation, used by onlyProxy/notDelegated to detect delegatecall execution context in UUPSUpgradeable.
constructor() initializer {}: marks the implementation contract as initialized so it cannot be hijacked.
initialize(): initializer-guarded entry point that sets name/symbol, owner and mints 1e9 OGV to the caller.
mint(address to, uint256 amount) public onlyOwner: privileged supply-inflation function.
_authorizeUpgrade(address newImplementation) internal override onlyOwner: access-control hook guarding proxy upgrades.
ERC20Upgradeable._mint(address account, uint256 amount): increases _totalSupply and _balances[account].
ERC20Upgradeable._transfer: moves balances and performs an unchecked subtraction on the sender balance.
ERC20Upgradeable.transfer(address to, uint256 amount): public token transfer that resolves the caller via _msgSender().
UUPSUpgradeable.upgradeTo(address newImplementation) external onlyProxy: calls _authorizeUpgrade then performs the upgrade.
ERC1967UpgradeUpgradeable._upgradeToAndCallUUPS: validates proxiableUUID and then upgrades, optionally executing a delegatecall with data.
_functionDelegateCall(address target, bytes data) private: performs a low-level delegatecall into an externally supplied address.
msg.sender used inside initialize() as the recipient of the 1,000,000,000 OGV initial mint.
msg.sender returned by ContextUpgradeable._msgSender() and compared against _owner in the onlyOwner modifier.
target.delegatecall(data) executed in _functionDelegateCall, granting the target full control of the proxy storage.
unchecked { _balances[from] = fromBalance - amount; } inside _transfer, an unchecked arithmetic write.
to parameter of mint(address to, uint256 amount).
amount parameter of mint(address to, uint256 amount).
account parameter of ERC20Upgradeable._mint(address account, uint256 amount).
amount parameter of ERC20Upgradeable._mint(address account, uint256 amount).
uint256 fromBalance = _balances[from] local variable inside _transfer.
newImplementation parameter of _authorizeUpgrade(address newImplementation).
to parameter of ERC20Upgradeable.transfer(address to, uint256 amount).
amount parameter of ERC20Upgradeable.transfer(address to, uint256 amount).

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the recipient of the 1e9 OGV initial mint inside initialize(), so whoever initializes first receives the supply.
initialize() calls _mint(msg.sender, 1000000000 * 10**decimals()).
The initializer modifier reads and writes _initialized to prevent a second call to initialize().
mint() forwards to ERC20Upgradeable._mint(to, amount).
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender() before allowing mint() to execute.
mint() privilege derives from the _owner state variable queried by the onlyOwner modifier.
_authorizeUpgrade is an override restricted by onlyOwner, gating upgradeability on msg.sender.
constructor() initializer {} sets _initialized on the implementation contract so initialize() cannot be re-run on it.
upgradeTo() calls _authorizeUpgrade(newImplementation) before performing the upgrade.
upgradeTo() calls _upgradeToAndCallUUPS(newImplementation, new bytes(0), false).
The onlyProxy modifier compares address(this) and _getImplementation() with __self to restrict upgradeTo to the active proxy.
_upgradeToAndCallUUPS executes _functionDelegateCall(newImplementation, data) when data.length > 0 or forceCall, handing control to arbitrary code.
_functionDelegateCall performs target.delegatecall(data), an external call into attacker-influenced code that runs in the proxy storage context.
The newImplementation parameter becomes the delegatecall target executed inside the proxy context.
newImplementation flows into _upgradeToAndCallUUPS only after the _authorizeUpgrade access check.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply, the core supply accounting operation.
_mint credits _balances[account] with amount.
_transfer rewrites the sender and recipient entries of _balances.
_transfer enters an unchecked block to compute fromBalance - amount.
The cached fromBalance local variable is the operand of the unchecked subtraction.
transfer() delegates balance mutation to _transfer(owner, to, amount).
transfer() resolves address owner = _msgSender(), making msg.sender the source of the token move.
mint()'s to parameter is forwarded as the recipient of _mint.
mint()'s amount parameter is forwarded to _mint and added to the recipient's balance.
_mint's account parameter indexes the _balances mapping.
_mint's amount parameter increases _totalSupply.
transfer()'s to parameter becomes the recipient in _transfer.
transfer()'s amount parameter is the value subtracted and added in _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: param.mint.to is a call-site argument that only exists to feed the core mint() function; it has no independent semantics.
param.mint.amount is only meaningful as the amount supplied to the core mint() function.
param._mint.account is a purely local argument of the core _mint function and can be folded into it.
param._mint.amount is a purely local argument of the core _mint function and can be folded into it.
local._transfer.fromBalance is a temporary cached value inside the core _transfer function and carries no standalone semantics.
param._authorizeUpgrade.newImplementation is the argument of the core access-control function _authorizeUpgrade that vets it.
param.transfer.to is only the recipient argument of the core transfer() function.
param.transfer.amount is only the value argument of the core transfer() function.
